description: The chart illustrates “effect” values for multiple language families, showing six model–layer conditions per family with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “family,” with categories ordered left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 10, and 30 (with intermediate gridlines), spanning slightly below 0 up to the mid-30s. For each family, six adjacent bars are grouped: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with black capped error bars. Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (about 1–3 for L₂ and R₂ bars, and about 5–6 for B₂ bars); IE-Germanic shows L₂ around 9–10, R₂ near 0 to slightly negative, and B₂ around 14–15; IE-Indic shows L₂ near 0, R₂ around 20–22, and B₂ around 21–24; IE-Romance shows L₂ around 4–6, R₂ around 1–5, and B₂ around 5–12; IE-Slavic shows L₂ around 9–10, R₂ near 0–1, and B₂ around 14–16; IE-other shows L₂ around 5–6, R₂ near 0, and B₂ around 8–9; Isolate shows values clustered near 0–2 across all colors; Semitic shows L₂ around 11–16, R₂ slightly negative (around −2 to −1), and B₂ around 14–20; and Uralic shows values near 0–1 for most bars with a small pink bar around ~2. The bars are not sorted by magnitude but appear in a fixed family order, and no individual bars are specially highlighted beyond the consistent color legend and the presence of error bars.
